purpose: Replace hand-edited Goal Task registration with one manifest-directed transition whose receipt is the observation.

transition.predecessor: live base tip of data/canonical-task-registry.json (generation N)
transition.successor: generation N + 1 with exactly one appended row equal to the derived record

registration_modes.NEW_IDENTITY: no surface may hold the task_id; record, row, vector and index entry are derived from the manifest

EXISTING_IDENTITY.precondition: exactly one data/canonical-task-records/<task_id>.json and no aggregate row (CHECKED_OUT_SHARD_OMITTED_FROM_AGGREGATE); the manifest record equals the shard
EXISTING_IDENTITY.row: the shard record verbatim (row == record); the shard bytes are not rewritten; generation N -> N + 1
cosv_source: scripts/cosv.py encode_task(declared exact_metrics), which must equal any vector the shard records; then the vector record and index entry are emitted
else the shard's own recorded task.v1 vector, with residual COSV_EXACT_METRICS_NOT_OBSERVED
else FAIL_CLOSED COSV_NOT_DERIVABLE; no vector is ever assigned by the manifest
EXISTING_IDENTITY.schema_conformance: the authority floor is enforced; current-schema conformance is reported and, when absent, residual CANONICAL_RECORD_SCHEMA_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED names the record-data successor transition
EXISTING_IDENTITY.state: the recorded coordination_state is projected as recorded; claim-asserting states (CLAIMED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETION_CLAIMED) or a worker_claim with claim_ref/fence_ref are refused; an unclaimed non-PROPOSED state is residual CLAIM_NOT_ISSUED_BY_WORKERCOORDINATOR
EXISTING_IDENTITY.existing_record_preflight: StegVerse-Labs/.github#3306 consumes the resulting single row (row == shard, matching COSV)

registration_modes.every_allow: evidence.workercoordinator_claim_request: a request to WorkerCoordinator (claim_ref/fence_ref null, request_grants_claim_authority false); scripts/allocate_claims.py remains the claim authority
registration_modes.collision_checkin: plan and apply run scripts/check_registry_collision_checkin.py (Labs#3254) over predecessor -> derived successor with its event ledger empty and its clock pinned; a refusal writes nothing
registration_modes.allocation: allocation_request_ref binds a control/goal-task-allocation-requests proposal; it is checked against the derivation and never adopted

governing_invariants: docs/ECOSYSTEM_ECONOMIC_WHITEPAPER_GATED_ROADMAP_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md:19 (COSV emitted by the Registry path; no manual vector)
nonclaims: Registration is not admission, claim, fence or execution authority.
A green verify run is source validation, not runtime reality.
This contract does not amend schemas/canonical-task-record.schema.json; the derived record adds the registry's existing cosv_task_vector and source_state_vector_ref binding fields.
EXISTING_IDENTITY registers a row for an identity that already exists; it is not an admission, claim, schema migration or COSV derivation for that identity.
